info.title: Dojo API
info.description: REST API for Dojo LMS — courses, chapters, purchases, promo codes, blog posts, and more. Uses OAuth2 with JWT access tokens and refresh token rotation.

bearerAuth.description: JWT access token obtained from POST /api/oauth/token

post.description: Create a new user account with email and password. Does not return a token — use POST /api/oauth/token with grant_type=password to log in.
Obtain an access token using password, client_credentials, or refresh_token grant. Returns a JWT access token (15-min expiry) and optionally a refresh token (30-day expiry with rotation).

400.description: Invalid request or unsupported grant type

get.description: Returns user profile from the JWT access token

post.description: Creates a new OAuth2 client. The client_secret is returned only once — store it securely.

parameters.name: clientId
parameters.description: The client_id of the OAuth2 client

get.description: Returns published courses for public users, all courses for admins. Supports pagination, search, and category filtering.
Returns course with chapters and attachments. Unpublished courses visible only to admins.

patch.description: Requires title, description, image, price, and at least one published chapter to publish.

post.summary: Add a chapter to a course

delete.description: If no published chapters remain, the course is automatically unpublished.

post.summary: Add an attachment to a course

post.description: Mock payment — always succeeds. Optionally apply a promo code for a discount. Creates Purchase record, PromoCodeUsage, and increments counter in a single transaction.

404.description: Course not found or not published

post.description: Checks if a promo code is valid for a course. Validates: exists, active, not expired, uses not exceeded, user hasn't already used it. Returns discount info.

200.description: List of purchases with course info

get.description: Returns completion status for each chapter in a course.

400.description: No valid fields or update failed

get.summary: List promo codes for a course

post.description: Code must be 3-20 uppercase chars/digits/hyphens. Discount 1-100%. Expiration must be in the future.
Admin only. Max 50 MB. Allowed types: images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG), PDF, ZIP, text, markdown, JSON, Office docs (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX). Files are stored with UUID filenames.

400.description: No file, too large, or type not allowed
